title: Mara and the Parish
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Lena Pemberton, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
